Projects

Selected systems.

Portfolio pieces framed the way hiring teams evaluate engineering work: problem, architecture, stack, and measurable proof.

Current platform

Astravi

AI work-intelligence platform that converts activity files into per-screenshot VLM captions, semantic activity records, rolling summaries, decision gates, privacy-safe recommendations, and adoption signals.

  • Processes completed activity JSON into stable screenshot IDs, sequence numbers, vision captions, semantic records, and resumable MongoDB workflow state.
  • Uses decision logic before generation, so recommendations are created only when there is a real evidence-backed opportunity.
  • Validates recommendation publishing through confidence, action type, evidence IDs, retry feedback, and low-confidence suppression.
  • Governed search flows through sanitized intent, cache reuse, rate limits, stripped URL data, and fallback evidence via ToolGateway.
  • Tracks adoption states such as generated, displayed, researched, likely in progress, implemented, superseded, or expired.
  • Designed for client-facing explainability: clear recommendation reasons, privacy boundaries, and team-friendly handoff points.
